consent.title: Privacy notice
consent.body:
workingRun collects only what the activity needs: employee ID, display name, department, run data (date, distance, time) and evidence photos.

• Display names, points and ranks are visible to all participants.
• Evidence photos are visible only to you and reviewers, and are deleted automatically 90 days after upload.
• GPS location is removed from photos before upload.
• Other data is kept until the program ends, then the whole system is deleted.
• You may request deletion at any time through the activity admin.

[Your legal/DPO team should review this text before launch.]
